title: Uncertainty budget of a reconciliation boundary: two independent 3 t readings give 4.24 t combined and about 8.5 t expanded (k = 2); a full reactor-to-packing budget with a correlated inventory conversion
spec_ref: SME E4 (justified reconciliation tolerance), NIST TN 1297 section 5 (combined standard uncertainty with covariance), ACC09, D06

inputs.smeExample: difference of two independent mass readings, each standard uncertainty 3 t (sensitivity +1 and -1), coverage factor 2
inputs.fullBudget: residual = reactor totalizer - packing scale - silo stock change: meter u 1.5 t (c +1), scale u 0.8 t (c -1), silo inventory u 2.0 t (c -1), level-to-mass density conversion u 0.6 t (c +1), shift-boundary timing u 0.4 t (c +1); inventory and conversion correlated r = 0.5; k = 2
